name: Eleven-speed double crankset
weight_description: Manufacturer average 735.4 g for FC-MT700-2, 175 mm arms and 36/26T chainrings, explicitly without bottom bracket and without chain/bash guard. The 175 mm source reference is retained without converting to 170 mm. Other ring combinations and the outboard-chainline B2 version do not inherit this mass.
